In six-dimensional [[geometry]], a '''runcinated 5-simplex''' is a convex [[uniform 5-polytope]] with 3rd order [[Truncation (geometry)|truncations]] ([[Runcination]]) of the regular [[5-simplex]].

There are 4 unique runcinations of the 5-simplex with [[permutation]]s of truncations, and [[cantellation]]s.
{{clear}}

=== Alternate names ===
* Runcinated hexateron
* Small prismated hexateron (Acronym: spix) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/spix.htm (x3o3o3x3o - spix)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
The vertices of the ''runcinated 5-simplex'' can be most simply constructed on a [[hyperplane]] in 6-space as permutations of (0,0,1,1,1,2) ''or'' of (0,1,1,1,2,2), seen as facets of a [[runcinated 6-orthoplex]], or a [[biruncinated 6-cube]] respectively.

=== Images ===
{{5-simplex Coxeter plane graphs|t03|150}}

=== Alternate names ===
* Runcitruncated hexateron
* Prismatotruncated hexateron (Acronym: pattix) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/pattix.htm (x3x3o3x3o - pattix)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
The coordinates can be made in 6-space, as 180 permutations of:
: (0,0,1,1,2,3)

This construction exists as one of 64 [[orthant]] [[Facet (geometry)|facets]] of the [[runcitruncated 6-orthoplex]].

=== Images ===
{{5-simplex Coxeter plane graphs|t013|150}}

* Runcicantitruncated hexateron
* Great prismated hexateron (Acronym: gippix) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/gippix.htm (x3x3x3x3o - gippix)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
The coordinates can be made in 6-space, as 360 permutations of:
: (0,0,1,2,3,4)

This construction exists as one of 64 [[orthant]] [[Facet (geometry)|facets]] of the [[runcicantitruncated 6-orthoplex]].

=== Images ===
{{5-simplex Coxeter plane graphs|t0123|150}}

== Related uniform 5-polytopes ==
These polytopes are in a set of 19 [[A5 polytope|uniform 5-polytope]]s based on the [3,3,3,3] [[Coxeter group]], all shown here in A<sub>5</sub> [[Coxeter plane]] [[orthographic projection]]s. (Vertices are colored by projection overlap order, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple having progressively more vertices)

{{Hexateron family}}
